# Browser dependencies

- Marked 15.0.12 — https://github.com/markedjs/marked/tree/v15.0.12 — MIT, see marked-LICENSE.md.
- KaTeX 0.16.22 — https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/tree/v0.16.22 — MIT, see katex/LICENSE. The distribution includes its WOFF2 fonts.

These fixed local copies let reading pages work without a CDN. The Markdown and math renderers load only when a reading page needs them.

- Highlight.js 11.11.1 — https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js/tree/11.11.1 — BSD-3-Clause, see highlight-LICENSE.
- Mermaid 10.9.3 — https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/tree/v10.9.3 — MIT, see mermaid-LICENSE.
